rationale: Both are correct and similar. B is better structured. It separates verse, verseLine and bottles into small, well-named helpers, so Recite only joins verses with blank lines. It also removes the repeated opening-line formatting by calling verseLine twice. A puts all the verse construction inline in Recite and repeats the same Sprintf/title call for the first two lines. A's rune-based title function is a little more careful than B's byte slicing. That does not matter here because every word is ASCII. B's decomposition is cleaner and easier to read.
